text:
support-ops: customer MaplePay reported intermittent 401s on /v1/generate starting ~2026-11-02T02:10Z. attached logs show 'no matching kid' and 'signature verification failed'. ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/2452

olivia: looked at prod logs for tenant maple-pay. saw bursts of 401s with message: "jwt verification failed: no matching kid in JWKS" right after external IdP rotated keys at 02:03Z. Our JWKS cache ttl=3600s so we served stale keys until TTL expiry.

chen: can you paste the jwks headers? sometimes idp returns Cache-Control: max-age=300 or an ETag. sample: ```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: max-age=600, public
ETag: "v4"
Content-Type: application/json
```

olivia: vendor confirmed rotation at 02:03Z and their jwks now shows new kid 'kid-2026-11-02-02'. we didn't honor ETag/If-None-Match and we only re-fetch on TTL. Also observed ~3m of tokens failing with exp<now — looks like customer instances had NTP drift ~3m. so two orthogonal causes: stale JWKS + clock skew.

mike: for clock skew we already have leeway config but default is 30s. I'd be comfortable increasing to 300s (5m) for now; that's industry standard for JWT leeway. code example to add leeway: ```python
import jwt
payload = jwt.decode(token, key=pubkey, algorithms=["RS256"], leeway=300)
```

tara: another wrinkle: gateway's auth plugin caches Authorization header for 30s in edge cases; if it cached an old token and the IdP rotated mid-cache, we'd see nonce/signature mismatch. repro steps I ran: 
1) start local jwks server v1 with kid K1
2) issue token signed with K1
3) rotate jwks to K2 on jwks endpoint
4) gateway still cached old token and forwarded -> 401: no matching kid
5) after forcing JWKS refresh or after cache TTL, requests succeed

commands I used: ```bash
# fetch jwks
curl -i https://idp.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json
# simulate rotation by swapping file on test jwks server
```

olivia: mitigation plan:
- immediate: clear JWKS cache for affected tenant(s) and advise customer to sync NTP / reissue tokens
- short term: reduce JWKS TTL to 60s and add behavior: on signature verification failure with "no matching kid", fetch JWKS immediately and retry the verification once before returning 401
- medium term: implement proper Cache-Control/ETag honoring, If-None-Match requests, and telemetry for JWKS hits/misses and signature-error spikes
- security note: maintain leeway default but make configurable per deployment; add audit log entry when we retry fetching JWKS after sigfail

chen: I'll open PR with flag JWKS_REFRESH_ON_SIGFAIL=true and config jwks_ttl_seconds=60. will add unit tests + integration test against a local jwks server that rotates keys.

mike: make sure retry-on-sigfail does only one fetch+retry and rate-limits to avoid thundering herd if IdP offline.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: eng-runtime/jwks-cache-fix -> staging

support-ops: updated ticket with workaround and cleared cache for MaplePay. customer confirmed retries are succeeding now. we should prepare a postmortem with timeline if this affects more customers.

olivia: adding follow-ups: 
- PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-runtime/pull/432
- tests: integration test 'test_key_rotation_retry' added
- rollout plan: canary in us-west for 2 hours then global

tara: thumbs up. anything else for SOC? mike: we'll include security review for retry logic.

support-ops: thanks all, will notify customer and close escalation after 24h of no errors :thumbsup:
